text:
Love is like music,

it returns me with empty hands,

with time suddenly catching fire

outside paradise.

I know an island,

my memories,

and a future music,

the promise.


And I go toward the death that does not exist,

which is called horizon in my breast.

Always eternity out of time.

translation.title: Love Is Like Music
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the empty-handed return and eternity arriving out of time.
